answer: Duplicate registrations collapse because a terrace can bond only once, and forging a second claim requires corrupting independent witnesses across the canyon, whose collusion cost exceeds any reward from fake epochs. Sybil resistance comes from staking a unique, verifiable identity bonded to scarce physical work: each agent must prove control of a distinct registered juniper orchard terrace, signed by a local sensor and countersigned by two neighbors. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
